text.en: Pet owners consistently commend Linda for her exceptional attentiveness, professionalism, and warm approach towards boarding guests. Reviewers note that she clearly cares about each pet entrusted to the facility. Clients feel reassured by her reliable supervision and dedicated personal attention when leaving their animals in West Cork.

Clients emphasize that cats and dogs receive affectionate and conscientious care throughout their boarding stays. Reviewers note that visiting animals are treated with genuine kindness, ensuring they remain calm and comfortable in the cattery and kennel facilities. Pet guardians express strong trust when booking repeat stays for their companions.

q.en: Who manages the pet care at Clonakilty Kennels & Cattery?

a.en: Reviewers specifically commend Linda for her hands-on management, personal dedication, and attentive care for all visiting pets.

q.en: Does the facility board cats as well as dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients highlight the pleasant cattery facilities alongside boarding accommodation for dogs.

q.en: How do pet owners rate the quality of care?

a.en: Clients praise the boarding service as outstanding, highly professional, and dependable for companion animals.
